question: How is the seventeen-syllabled Kālī mantra-knowledge characterized in relation to the khaṇḍa-cakra?
premises: Kālī is identified as a vidyā.
This vidyā is situated in the khaṇḍa-cakra.
inference: Therefore the seventeen-syllabled Kālī vidyā is characterized as present in the khaṇḍa-cakra.
uncertainties: The exact technical sense of khaṃḍa+cakra is context-dependent.
plain_english: Kālī, situated in the khaṇḍa-cakra, is the seventeen-syllabled vidyā.
